Locations

Here are the opening times and locations for our foodbank centres. Everyone who comes to the foodbank for emergency food needs to have a valid foodbank voucher.

Address

41 the Harvey Centre (formerly Wilko – Opposite Tesco)
College Square
Town Centre
Harlow
Essex CM20 1LS

SALVATION ARMY HARLOW
Tendring Road
Harlow

CM18 6RN

Housham Hall Farm
Harlow Road
Matching Tye
Harlow
CM17 0PB

Directions via Google Maps

 
Need to access a foodbank voucher?	Important - Our foodbank works using a voucher referral system. In order to get help from our foodbank, you will need a voucher issued by local agencies. - Find out more
